annotation.title_clean: IEEE 7010-2020 IEEE Recommended Practice for Assessing the Impact of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems on Human Well-Being
annotation.title_en: IEEE 7010-2020 IEEE Recommended Practice for Assessing the Impact of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems on Human Well-Being
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society; WellbeingA/IS Working Group)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA catalogue page for IEEE 7010-2020, a recommended practice for assessing the impact of autonomous and intelligent systems on human well-being. It uses well-being indices and stakeholder engagement to guide product development, risk management, performance assessment, and the identification of intended and unintended users, uses and impacts.
key_provisions_or_claims: Measures the impact of A/IS on human well-being
Grounded in scientifically valid well-being indices and stakeholder engagement
Provides product development guidance and risk management support
Identifies intended and unintended users, uses and impacts of A/IS
Published 2020-05-01 by IEEE SMC Society WellbeingA/IS working group
